basis.provenanceNote: NC-LB-03 (art. 8.3) refuses expansion of niet-grondgebonden plots in the Landbouwstabiliseringsgebied; this variant documents the reconsideration reading by dropping the exclusion.

scenarios.name: Gebied agrarische bedrijven treated as hard exclusion

basis.provenanceNote: NC-LB-01 (art. 8.1) conditions agrarische bedrijven via a verbod plus voorschrift; this variant executes the strictest protective reading as a hard exclusion.

scenarios.name: Glastuinbouw designation taken at face value (no kassenconcentraties limit)

basis.rationale: Art. 8.6 explicitly refuses glasshouse expansion outside the kassenconcentraties (except the Ronde Venen relocation); ignoring it is not a defensible reading — it isolates how much area the concentration policy actually reserves.
basis.provenanceNote: NOT legally grounded as a reading of the verordening: the designation (NC-LB-05, art. 8.6) is cited; dropping it is purely analytical.

notes: Phase A deterministic sweep (docs/GENAI_SEAMS.md): no LLM at runtime; scenario specs are schema-validated contracts authored by deterministic-scenario-author#poc-v0.
Deltas are measured against the unmutated control re-executed over the baseline run's cached layers (same tunings), not against summary numbers.
Marker semantics (attention/conditional/compensation) never alter the opportunity zone; set_semantics mutations make that policy choice explicit and visible in the delta.
